events.title: Higher Open Expected For The Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market ticked higher again on Wednesday, one day after ending the two-day winning streak in which it had picked up more than 275 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,100-point plateau and it figures to open in the upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Mild Upside Expected For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market bounced higher again on Wednesday, one day after ending the two-day winning streak in which it had gained almost 40 points or 1.1 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,680-point plateau and it may extend those gains on Thursday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May See Continued Strength On Thursday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, jumping almost 1,000 points or 2.1 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 47,030-point plateau and it's expected to open in the green again on Thursday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Extend Wednesday's Gains
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Wednesday snapped the two-day slide in which it had slipped more than 25 points or 0.4 percent. The STI now sits just beneath the 5,400-point plateau and it may pick up steam on Thursday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Add To Its Winnings On Thursday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has moved higher in consecutive trading days, collecting almost 10 points or 0.6 percent along the way. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just below the 1,615-point plateau and it's tipped to open to the upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Break Resistance At 64,000 Points
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked higher in two straight sessions, rallying more than 1,750 points or 2.9 percent along the way. The Nikkei now sits just above the 63,950-point plateau and it figures to see additional support on Thursday.

events.title: Win Streak May Continue For South Korea Shares
events.description: The South Korea stock market has climbed higher in back-to-back sessions, surging almost 550 points or 10 percent in that span. The KOSPI now sits just above the 6,010-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Thursday.

events.title: Australia Export Price Data Due On Thursday
events.description: Australia will on Thursday release Q3 data for import and export prices, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ticks Lower Amid Fed Interest Rate Decision, Middle East Uncertainty
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value inched lower on Wednesday as U.S. keeps military options and diplomatic route to end the conflict with Iran open. Investors also assessed the reasons behind the interest rate decision by the U.S. Federal Reserve today.

events.title: Fed Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged, Pledges To 'Deliver Price Stability'
events.description: After raising interest rates for the first time in three years last month, the Federal Reserve on Wednesday announced its widely expected decision to leave interest rates unchanged following its latest meeting. The Fed said it decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75 to 4.0 percent in support of its dual goals.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Marginally Down; Logitech Tanks On Results
events.description: The Switzerland stock market, which opened on a weak note on Wednesday, languished in negative territory except for a few minutes a little past mid-afternoon, as investors largely made cautious moves, reacting to earnings and other corporate news.

events.title: Major European Markets Close Flat As Investors React To Earnings Ahead Of Fed Policy
events.description:
European stocks turned in a mixed performance on Wednesday as investors reacted to a slew of corporate earnings announcements and looked ahead to the monetary policy announcement from the Federal Reserve later in the day. 

A sharp rise in oil prices rendered the mood a bit cautious.

events.title: Energy Stocks Shine In Canadian Market; BoC Raises Interest Rate
events.description: Canadian stocks are turning in a mixed performance on Wednesday with investors digesting the Bank of Canada's announcement of a 25-basis point rate hike, in addition to tracking corporate earnings news and the trend in commodities markets.
